title: The Langmuir isotherm
caption: Gas molecules adsorb on a fixed number of surface sites. The fraction covered, θ = Kp/(1 + Kp), rises in proportion at low pressure and levels at 1 when every site is full (a monolayer). Half coverage occurs at p = 1/K.
alt: Fraction of the surface covered against pressure: rising steeply, then levelling towards 1; θ = 0.5 at p = 0.5 for K = 2.
description: High pressure: θ → 1, a full monolayer.
